goal: Extract the cohesive comparison-failure parsing and value-holding logic from TeamCityPlugin to reduce the target class's implementation complexity.

ops.details: Extract the existing nested ComparisonFailure class into a top-level ComparisonFailure class in the same package, including COMPARE_PATTERNS, parse(String), parse(String, Pattern), expected, actual, the constructor, getExpected(), and getActual(). Update TeamCityPlugin to reference the extracted class while preserving the existing ComparisonFailure.parse(message.trim()) behavior.
